description: This Java source file defines a factory class for creating an Akka actor used for health checking and caching the health status of the search service. It specifically constructs Props for the health checking actor, configuring child actors based on search configuration, including persistence health checks and background synchronization status reporting.

classes.name: SearchHealthCheckingActorFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that provides a static method for creating Props for a health checking actor related to the search service. It encapsulates actor creation logic based on the provided SearchConfig and a background sync proxy actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props configuration for a health checking actor, setting up child actors for persistence health check and background sync status reporting based on the configuration provided.
